themes.name: Mira's Wonder
themes.description: The main theme — curiosity made melody; returns whenever Mira chooses courage over fear, fully stated at the finale.

emotional_arc.feel: Peril and play at tiny scale, accelerating

protected_silences.note: The shrink lands in silence per scene_direction rhythm — first sound after is her own breath.

score_architecture.continuity_notes: All cues share F-major family; tempo steps up by ~8 bpm per act, never mid-cue.

variants.style_school: Warm orchestral family-film language — strings and celesta, classic wonder register.
variants.prompt: Instrumental main theme for a stylized 3D family short film: warm strings and celesta carry a lilting 6/8 melody in F major, curious and brave, gentle build to a hopeful cadence. No vocals. Clean cinematic mix.

variants.style_school: Playful chamber-quirk — pizzicato, clarinet and toy piano, comedy-forward.
variants.prompt: Instrumental main theme for a whimsical family short film: pizzicato strings, clarinet and toy piano in a playful 6/8, mischievous but warm, small comic stingers, hopeful ending. No vocals.

music_cues.prompt: Opening cue in the approved AV01 style: warm strings and celesta, lilting 6/8 in F major, ordinary-morning warmth that thins to uneasy sparseness in the final ten seconds. Instrumental, no vocals, clean cinematic mix, gentle tail for a dialogue entrance.
music_cues.qc_notes: Tail clears the S04 dialogue entrance.

sfx_cues.source_line: sound_direction: a glassy chime swallows the room as she shrinks
sfx_cues.prompt: A single glassy magical chime with a soft reverse-swell, swallowing room tone, 2 seconds

mix_plan.dialogue_law: Clip dialogue is baked in by Seedance and is untouchable: no filter touches clip audio except loudness normalization; music and SFX yield via sidechain ducking.
mix_plan.notes: Master loudnorm two-pass on the final mix.
